label: class_c_07_history_01
text: Greetings, my little students. Whatever you did\nyesterday, it is now a part of history.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_07_history_02
text: Today is our last class, so I would like to unravel\nthe marvels that history has presented to us\r\none last time.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_07_history_03
text: In our last class, I taught you about the Area Zero\nExpedition of two hundred years ago, correct?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_07_history_04
text: Alas, two hundred years is not that long ago.\nNot that long ago at all.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_07_history_05
text: How unfortunate that our history lessons must\nmarch so inexorably toward the future.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_07_history_06
text:
Would it not be more of an adventure to march
toward the past instead?\c
To start from our present and study history
in reverse?![VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_07_select_a
text: I think it would!

label: class_c_07_select_b
text: That might be hard to follow...

label: class_c_07_history_07a
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]So you agree with me, do you,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?\c
However, I’m afraid I risk incurring the wrath of
our dear director if I stray from the curriculum.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_07_history_07b
text: Indeed. It may be difficult to understand the\nflow of events—how one thing leads to another—\r\nif we were to trace history in reverse.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_07_history_08
text: *sigh* I suppose I have no choice but to let the\nflow of time carry us toward the future.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_07_history_09
text: In this last class of ours, I shall fill your minds with\nthe history of the Terastal phenomenon.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_07_history_10
text: The technology behind Tera Orbs has its origins\nin Area Zero.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_07_history_11
text: Even after the Area Zero Expedition supposedly\nreached the crater’s deepest depths, others\r\ncontinued to explore that area...[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_07_history_12
text: And, around 140 years ago, Pokémon cloaked\nin a mysterious light were discovered there.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_07_history_13
text: As you may have already guessed, these were, in\nfact, Terastallized Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_07_history_14
text:
However, when those who discovered these
Pokémon brought them out of Area Zero, the
light faded, and the Terastal phenomenon
remained a mystery for quite some time.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_07_history_15
text: However, 10 years ago—ugh, that might as well\nbe present day—a certain someone you have\r\ndefinitely heard of unraveled this mystery.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_07_history_16
text: Aha. Perfect timing to make eye contact, young\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]. Answer me this...[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_07_history_17
text: What is the name of the famous professor who\nunraveled the Terastal phenomenon mystery?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_07_select_01
text: Professor Heath

label: class_c_07_select_02a
text: Professor Sada

label: class_c_07_select_02b
text: Professor Turo

label: class_c_07_select_03
text: Professor Clavell

label: class_c_07_history_answer_01
text: Incorrect! Heath is the one who wrote the record\nof the Area Zero Expedition’s activities. You must\r\nbe remembering our last class together.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_07_history_answer_02
text: Correct! To think that you—a new transfer to our\nacademy—could correctly answer this question...\r\nYou must be very diligent in your studies.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_07_history_answer_03
text: Incorrect! Or, no...perhaps you are correct, in a\nroundabout sort of way...[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_07_history_18a
text: Approximately 10 years ago, a professor\nnamed Sada unraveled the mystery of the\r\nTerastal phenomenon.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_07_history_18b
text: Approximately 10 years ago, a professor\nnamed Turo unraveled the mystery of the\r\nTerastal phenomenon.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_07_history_19a
text: She discovered that the shining crystals down in\nArea Zero—or rather, the energy they emit—is\r\nwhat causes Pokémon to Terastallize.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_07_history_19b
text: He discovered that the shining crystals down in\nArea Zero—or rather, the energy they emit—is\r\nwhat causes Pokémon to Terastallize.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_07_history_20
text:
This led the professor to invent Tera Orb
technology and to develop a practical use for it.\c
This technology was then shared with both the
Pokémon League and our academy.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_07_history_21
text: Rumor has it that Director Clavell was one of the\nresearchers on the professor’s team...[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_07_history_22
text: Alas. This story is much less exciting now that\nsomeone we all know appears in it.\c\nModern history truly is dull, isn’t it?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_07_history_23
text:
Thus ends my history classes. Our next session
will be our final exam.\c
Bring the wonders of history to the forefront of
your minds in preparation.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
